SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS PO_NO, KEY_2 AS PO_SEQ, KEY_3 AS DS_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'DSDOWN' AND TARGET IN ('KRHYOS0017','KRHYOS0018') AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL GROUP BY DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT NVL(A.LEGACY_PO_NO ,' ') AS PO_NO, NVL(A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,' ') AS PO_SEQ, NVL(B.DS_DATE,' ') AS DELIVERY_DATE, NVL(B.ADD_DATE,' ') AS CREATION_DATE, FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMPORS B WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND B.DS_SEQ = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$' AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS ^= 'D' AND A.STATUS ^= 'D' ORDER BY A.BUYER,A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ,B.DS_SEQ
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 ='$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 ='$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
